description:
What the beatandraise.com tools cover, where they stop, and what to use instead.

Call it when a tool returned nothing, an error or less than the user needed, or the user
asks for something you cannot find a tool for. Put the user's need in their own words in
question ("institutional ownership of SPY", "Risk Factors of a 40-F") and the tool that fell
short in tool_name. The most relevant entries come first. The question is recorded, as every
call's arguments are, and tells us what to add. A user who wants a reply can write to
support@beatandraise.com.

Args:
    question: What the user wanted, in their words
    tool_name: The tool that did not give it, if any (e.g. "get_institutional_holders")
name: get_help
title: Get Help: Coverage and Limits
